message:
rust/avoidable-closure could not check any package, and fails instead of skipping because nothing was checked: `cargo dylint --version` failed (exit status: 1) without saying that cargo-dylint is missing, so this is a `cargo` that is broken or older than the lock and not a machine without cargo-dylint. Its standard error was:
error: toolchain 'nightly-2026-11-30-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu' is not installed
help: run `rustup toolchain install` to install it
Installed tools that lag toolchain.lock.json cause this; run `mise run toolchain:install` in this checkout.
